scenario: 今天 AI 搜索赛道有 10 篇，主线是检索链路里哪一段最值得换。Google 的 EmbeddingGemma 2 用一个小模型直接编码文字、图片、视频和音频；指令检索那篇把原有正例改造成最难的负例来造训练数据。RAG 一侧，LTRR 按问题挑检索器，Tessera 在读之前把网页拆成补全表头的小单元，QESChunker 用问答记录决定在哪里切块，DISCo 找一组合起来能覆盖 query 的文档。agent 方向，RouteDRAG 学什么时候启用 agent，另一篇在文档图上扣掉因连接多而虚高的分数。query 改写有两篇：GRAPE 用检索排名当奖励，电商挑战赛冠军方案把任务型 query 锚定到目录用词。

papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
papers.authors: Henrique Schechter Vera, Sahil Dua, Jovan Andonov, Sara Smoot, Sebastian Russo, Ivan Llanos, Max Matveev, Jae Hyeon Yoo, Kat Black, Shih-Cheng Huang, Josiah Aklilu, Maarten Grootendorst, Omar Sanseviero, Chandramouli Amarnath, Ian Ballantyne, Zhe Li, Daniel Salz, Ibrahim Alabdulmohsin, Ilya Philippov, Kristen Quan, Glenn Cameron, Edouard Yvinec, Luciano Martins, Doug Reid, Sindhu Raghuram Panyam, Weiyi Wang, Hengxuan Ying, Madhuri Shanbhogue, Tanmaya Dabral, Shanfeng Zhang, Juyeong Ji, Renjie Wu, Joe Zou, Xu Chen, Yunan Zhang, Yu-Hui Chen, Matthew Soulanille, Vinod Mamillapalli, Yi-Chun Kuo, Wai Hon Law, Matt Kreileder, Alice Zheng, Suril Shah, Mogan Shieh, Pooja Consul, Alberto Montes, Andreas Hess, Andres Sevilla, Babak Samari, Brendan McCloskey, Brian Potetz, Daniel Cer, Georgios Kathareios, Gustavo Hernández Ábrego, Hesen Zhang, Ji Ma, Jiaxing Wu, Keegan Mosley, Paul Suganthan, Rui Meng, Shen Gao, Shengcao Cao, Yi-Ting Chen, Yichang Chen, Zhongli Ding, Kendra Byrne, Cormac Brick, Olivier Lacombe, Qin Yin, Tris Warkentin, Armand Joulin, Tom Duerig, Mojtaba Seyedhosseini
papers.abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.
papers.summary: 想让一个 embedding 模型同时搜文字、图片、视频和音频，常见做法是先把音频转成文字、给图片配说明，再交给文本模型，既多花算力，又丢掉了语气和画面细节。Google 的 EmbeddingGemma 2 用一个 744M 参数的模型，把这几种输入直接映射到同一个向量空间，各模态编码器还能按需加载。用语音提问去找文本段落最能说明差别：同一个模型先把语音转写成文字再检索，MRR@10 是 57.59，直接读音频能到 69.54。==小模型做多模态，不一定要牺牲文本和代码==，它的代码检索分数反而比上一代高出近十分。

papers.title: Natural Hard-Negative Mining from Positives for Instruction-Following Retrieval
papers.authors: Chaolang Li, Jingyu Li, Zhaocheng Du, Xuyang Xie, Gang Wang, Pengwen Dai
papers.abstract: Instruction-following information retrieval (IFIR) requires retrievers to rank documents by both a query and its instance-specific instructions, yet instruction-conditioned contrastive supervision remains scarce. Existing synthetic methods typically fix a positive passage and generate additional negatives, overlooking the hard-negative potential of the original positive. We propose Natural Hard-Negative Mining (NHNM), which promotes convertible negatives under query-compatible instructions and repurposes original positives as natural instruction hard negatives. Its automated Candidate Cleaning, Reversal Construction, and Geometry Filtering pipeline produces compact, high-contrast supervision aligned with the pretrained retrieval space. Applied to MSMARCO, NHNM yields NHNM-MARCO, an IFIR training set of nearly 7K instances. On InstructIR and FollowIR, models with 568M to 4B parameters fine-tuned on NHNM-MARCO achieve strong instruction-following performance and match or surpass substantially larger retrievers in several settings. Controlled analyses and ablations attribute these gains to natural hard-negative supervision rather than model scale or training-data volume.
papers.summary: 带指令的检索要求同一个 query 在不同指令下排出不同结果：指令加了一条额外要求后，原来的正例如果不满足这条要求，就该往后排。这种训练数据很少，现有做法是固定正例，再让大模型编一段违反指令的负例。这篇论文反过来做：从原有负例里挑一篇满足某个额外条件的文档，生成一句短指令把它扶正，原来的正例在这句指令下自然成了最难的负例。在 MS MARCO 上只造了 6,716 条数据，小号的 Qwen3-Embedding 训练后，在 InstructIR 上，同一 query 配上多条不同用户指令，取排得最差那次的前十名 nDCG，这个分数从 49.29 升到 67.06，超过大十倍以上的 Promptriever。

deep_reading.title: Natural Hard-Negative Mining from Positives for Instruction-Following Retrieval

papers.title: LTRR: Learning To Rank Retrievers for LLMs
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically rely on a single fixed retriever, despite growing evidence that no single retriever performs optimally across all query types. In this paper, we explore a query routing approach that dynamically selects from a pool of retrievers based on the query, using both train-free heuristics and learned routing models. We frame routing as a learning-to-rank problem and introduce LTRR, a framework that Learns To Rank Retrievers according to their expected contribution to downstream RAG performance. Through experiments on diverse question-answering benchmarks with controlled variations in query types, we demonstrate that routing-based RAG consistently surpasses the strongest single-retriever baselines. The gains are particularly substantial when training with the Answer Correctness (AC) objective and when using pairwise ranking methods, with XGBoost yielding the best results. Additionally, our approach exhibits stronger generalization to out-of-distribution queries. Overall, our results underscore the critical role of both training strategy and optimization metric choice in effective query routing for RAG systems.

papers.summary: RAG 系统一般只接一个固定的检索器，但不同问题适合的检索器不同，有些问题干脆不检索、只靠模型自己答更好。这篇论文把选检索器当成排序问题：对每个训练问题，记下每个检索器让答案质量比不检索提高了多少，再训练一个排序模型给检索器排名，不检索也是候选之一。在六个由稀疏、稠密检索和不同重排组合出的检索器上，pairwise XGBoost 路由把答案正确率分从最好单一检索器的 0.5776 提到 0.5900，而每题都选对的上限是 0.7948。==路由的收益是真实的，但离上限还很远==，而且训练标签选哪种答案质量指标影响很大。

papers.title: A Dense Subset Index for Collective Query Coverage
papers.authors: Kartik Nair, Pritish Chakraborty, Atharva Abhijit Tambat, Indradyumna Roy, Soumen Chakrabarti, Anirban Dasgupta, Abir De
papers.abstract: In traditional information retrieval, corpus items compete with each other to occupy top ranks in response to a query.  In contrast, in many recent retrieval scenarios associated with complex, multi-hop question answering or text-to-SQL, items are not self-complete: they must instead collaborate, i.e., information from multiple items must be combined to respond to the query. In the context of modern dense retrieval, this need translates into finding a small collection of corpus items whose contextual word vectors collectively cover the contextual word vectors of the query. The central challenge is to retrieve a near-optimal collection of covering items in time that is sublinear in corpus size. By establishing coverage as a submodular objective, we enable successive dense index probes to quickly assemble an item collection that achieves near-optimal coverage.  Successive query vectors are iteratively `edited', and the dense index is built using random projections of a novel, lifted dense vector space. Beyond rigorous theoretical guarantees, we report on a scalable implementation of this new form of vector database. Extensive experiments establish the empirical success of DISCo, in terms of the best coverage vs. query latency tradeoffs.
papers.summary: 传统检索里，文档彼此竞争前几名；但在多跳问答或 text-to-SQL 里，单篇文档往往不完整，答案要靠几篇拼起来。放到稠密检索上，这就是找一小组文档，让它们的 token 向量合起来覆盖 query 的每个 token 向量。这里的覆盖，指 query 的每个 token 向量都能在选中的文档里找到相近的 token 向量。这篇论文证明覆盖程度满足次模性，也就是每多加一篇文档，新增的覆盖只会越来越少，所以可以一轮轮查询向量索引，每轮找能补上最多未覆盖部分的文档，贪心地凑出接近最优的组合，耗时随语料规模亚线性增长。作者据此实现了一种新的向量数据库 DISCo，在覆盖率和查询延迟的权衡上优于对比方法。需要多篇证据拼答案的 RAG，用这个目标比用 top-k 更贴切。

papers.title: GRAPE: Let GRPO Supervise Query Rewriting by Ranking for Retrieval
papers.authors: Zhaohua Zhang, Jianhuan Zhuo, Muxi Chen, Chenchen Zhao, Wenyu Jiang, Mingyang Chen, Yu Tang, Qiuyong Xiao, Tianwen Jiang, Jihong Zhang, Zhixun Su
papers.abstract: The CLIP model has established itself as a cornerstone of large-scale retrieval systems. However, its performance often degrades under distributional shifts such as multilingual, long-form, or multimodal queries. To avoid the prohibitive costs associated with retriever retraining or corpus re-embedding, we propose GRAPE (Grouped Ranking-Aware Policy Optimization Enhancement), a plug-and-play approach that leverages LLM-based query rewriting to bridge these gaps. Unlike existing methods that lack explicit supervision, GRAPE integrates ranking signals into the rewriting LLM via Grouped Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), ensuring rewritten queries are better aligned with the frozen retriever’s latent distribution. Crucially, we identify a score inflation phenomenon in naive similarity-based finetuning—where irrelevant candidates receive indiscriminately high scores—and mitigate it with a novel corpus-relative ranking-based reward. Extensive experiments across multilingual (Flickr30k-CN, CVLUE, XM3600), long-form (Wikipedia), and multimodal (CIRR) benchmarks demonstrate that GRAPE consistently improves performance, achieving an average gain of 4.9% in Recall@10 without any modification to the underlying retriever.The code is available at https://github.com/mogulzhang/GRAPE.
papers.summary: CLIP 这类检索模型遇到中文 query、长文本 query 或图文组合 query 时效果明显下滑，可重训检索器、重算整库向量又太贵。这篇论文不动检索器，只训练一个大模型来改写 query，并用 GRPO 把检索排名直接当作改写的奖励。作者发现，如果奖励只看改写后的 query 和正确结果有多相似，模型会学会把所有候选的分数一起抬高，无关结果也跟着变高。改成看正确结果在整个语料里排第几，这个问题就消失了。在多语言、长文本和组合图像检索的多个基准上，Recall@10 平均提高 4.9%。检索模型冻结、语料很大的系统，可以先从改写 query 下手。

papers.title: Tessera: Structure-Completed Evidence Units for Web Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Peichun Hua, He Sun, Zirui Zhuang, Qi Qi, Yiming Qiu, Shinan Liu, Yunming Xiao
papers.abstract: Web retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) splits a page into fixed-size text chunks or, in recent visual pipelines, screenshot tiles, and the retrieved item serves at once as the unit of indexing, ranking, and reading. We trace answer evidence from source HTML to reader input over the full English Wikipedia and find that this coupling loses evidence in text and screenshot pipelines alike: evidence present in the source page often fails to reach the reader intact, particularly structured content such as tables and infoboxes, which chunking separates from the headers and context that give it meaning. Stronger extraction, context expansion, and larger reader budgets leave the loss in place. We present Tessera, a training-free evidence delivery layer that decouples what a pipeline retrieves from what its reader reads. Given the pages behind any ranked list, Tessera rebuilds their HTML into fine-grained evidence units, each completed with its page title, section path, and table headers, selects the units relevant to the query, and packs them into the reader context at an unchanged token budget. The index, the retriever, and the reader stay as they are, so Tessera applies to text, screenshot, and agentic pipelines. Across three question answering benchmarks, Tessera improves answer accuracy by 5 to 6 points on text and screenshot pipelines, consistently across readers, retrievers, and reader budgets, and outperforms strong HTML-aware and structure-aware RAG baselines under matched budgets. The gains carry over to multi-step agentic search. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/sarendis56/Tessera.
papers.summary: 问维基百科《欢乐糖果屋》的制片人是谁，答案就在页面信息框的制片一行，可文本抽取把这一格里的两个名字弄丢了，读者模型只看到导演，于是答错。这篇论文在整个英文维基百科上把答案证据从网页源码一路追到读者输入，发现这种丢失很普遍：7.6% 的问题证据根本没完整进索引，其中 81% 是表格单元格、表头或图注。Tessera 检索照旧，只在读之前把排名靠前的网页重新拆成一行表格、一个列表项这样的小单元，补上标题、章节和表头，再挑相关的装进同样的 token 预算。文本和截图两类流水线的答对率都提高 5 到 6 个点。

papers.title: QESChunker: A Single Objective Unifies Overlapping and Non-Overlapping Chunking for RAG
papers.authors: Yifan Zhao, Qianyang Zhao, Xinyu Guan, kai wei, Yuming Deng
papers.abstract: Chunking is a fundamental preprocessing step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet most existing chunkers rely primarily on heuristics. We introduce the Question--Evidence-Supervised Chunker (QESChunker), to our knowledge the first method for constructing static chunk indices from question--evidence supervision. QESChunker constructs document-specific chunk indices by optimizing over human-annotated or LLM-generated question--evidence pairs, without access to held-out test queries. We formulate non-overlapping and overlapping index construction through a unified question--evidence utility-maximization objective, turning chunking into a supervised combinatorial optimization problem. Under the non-overlap constraint, the objective decomposes over chunks and can be optimized exactly in polynomial time by dynamic programming. When overlap is allowed, the objective becomes monotone submodular; exact optimization is NP-hard, but our greedy achieves a $(1-1/\sqrt{e})$-approximation. Across two self-constructed and three public datasets, both variants outperform existing chunking methods in complete-evidence recall in nearly all evaluated settings, under the same overlap regime and a fixed hybrid retriever. These results recast chunking as supervised, budget-aware index construction for evidence retrieval.
papers.summary: RAG 的切块大多靠经验，固定长度、按段落或按语义相似度切，没有一种方法直接以问题的证据能否被完整取回为目标。这篇论文用已有的问题和对应证据来决定每份文档在哪里切，目标是让尽量多的证据段落落进能被这个问题检索到的块里。不允许重叠时，这个目标可以按块拆开，用动态规划精确求出最优切法；允许重叠时问题变成 NP 难，就用贪心近似求解。在两个中文政策语料和三个英文公开数据集上，固定同一个混合检索器，按证据被完整取回的比例比较，不重叠版在 10 个对比设置里有 9 个排第一，重叠版 10 个全是第一，而且返回的上下文越少，优势越大。它适合被反复查询、已经积累了问答记录的文档库。

papers.title: TaskBridge: Technical Report for SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge
papers.authors: Zhiheng Fu, Yupeng Hu, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Qinlei Huang, Shaokun Wang, Han Liu, Fan Liu, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie
papers.abstract: The SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge Query Reformulation Task evaluates the reformulation of task-oriented queries into expressions suitable for product retrieval, followed by BM25-based retrieval. These queries often imply product needs through activity-level semantics, creating a lexical gap with catalog descriptions. Systems must preserve task intent while adapting the number of reformulations to the Automatic and Interactive protocols. We propose TaskBridge, a catalog-anchored framework comprising Catalog Semantic Anchoring, Unified Five-Candidate Rewriting, and Protocol-Aware Selection. It grounds queries in catalog vocabulary, generates five complementary reformulations, and selects one query for Automatic retrieval or up to four for Interactive retrieval using BM25 scores, query-product reranking, and weighted Jaccard overlap. The selected queries are independently executed using BM25 to produce results in the required six-column format. Experiments demonstrate improved retrieval effectiveness, with multiple complementary queries providing additional gains in the Interactive setting. TaskBridge achieved first place in the SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge.
papers.summary: 电商里很多 query 说的是要做的事，而不是要买的东西。比如用户输入“做千层面”，要的是烤盘、食材和厨具，商品标题里却没有这几个词，BM25 很难召回。这篇电商挑战赛的冠军方案先把 query 和商品目录里的类目、实体词对齐，再让大模型一次生成五条互补的改写，最后按评测协议挑选：自动模式只交质量最高的一条；交互模式最多交四条，在五选四的各组里先比平均质量，再比组内检索结果的最大重合度，重合越少越好。每条改写的质量，是用它跑 BM25 取回商品后，重排模型给前五个商品的相关分按名次加权平均。==任务型 query 的改写要锚定在目录用词上==，否则大模型想出来的商品词未必搜得到。

papers.title: RouteDRAG: Learning to Route and Control Agentic Execution for Multimodal Document RAG
papers.authors: Zekai Chen, Hao Zhu, Yu Liu, Xunkai Li, Zejian Kang, Rui Qian, Quanjiang Li, Rong-Hua Li
papers.abstract: Web-based applications increasingly rely on understanding long multimodal documents, where answering questions often requires combining information across pages, tables, and figures. Agentic retrieval-augmented generation addresses these tasks through iterative retrieval and reasoning. However, Agentic execution is not always necessary, introducing additional computation and potentially incorrect answers. Our empirical analysis reveals that Agentic execution provides query-dependent benefits, while additional operations may improve, preserve, or degrade answer accuracy. These findings motivate controlling both Agent invocation and subsequent execution. To address these challenges, we propose RouteDRAG, a learning-based framework comprising four components. Unified Document Index organizes multimodal content into a graph-backed index and derives query representations from initial retrieval. Adaptive Path Routing preserves exact answering and predicts the relative benefit of Agent over shorter execution paths. Dynamic Agent Execution maintains an evolving workspace and refines Planner proposals to control tool use and termination. Sequential Policy Learning first trains operation control from observed outcomes and then trains path routing using the resulting Agent's performance. Across two benchmarks, RouteDRAG achieves an average accuracy improvement of 3.47 percentage points over shorter-path-only execution while assigning only 79.3% of queries to Agent. Notably, it also surpasses uniform Agent execution on both benchmarks while requiring fewer answering calls. Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG.
papers.summary: 长文档多模态问答里，agent 式的反复检索和推理并不总是有用：有些问题一次检索就能答对，多走几步反而可能把对的答案改错。作者先用实验说明，多调用一次工具，答案可能变好、不变，也可能变坏。RouteDRAG 因此学两件事：每个问题要不要交给 agent，以及 agent 执行时每一步要不要继续调用工具、什么时候停。在两个基准上，它比只走短路径平均高 3.47 个百分点，同时只把 79.3% 的问题交给 agent，而且比所有问题都走 agent 更准、调用回答模型的次数更少。==该不该启用 agent，本身就值得学==。

papers.title: When Connectivity Misleads: Guiding Agentic Search with Contrastive Evidence Paths
papers.authors: Junchen Li, Liang Xu, Rongzheng Wang, Qizhi Chen, Junhao Wen, Shuang Liang
papers.abstract: Search agents can use cross-document graphs to discover sources through multi-hop connections and choose subsequent actions based on candidate rankings and relationships within a limited observation window. However, documents may rank highly because their numerous connections make them easier to reach, without necessarily providing more valuable evidence. Graph diffusion methods such as Personalized PageRank (PPR) aggregate propagation contributions from multiple sources, allowing highly connected distractor nodes to crowd the observation window. Flat node scores also obscure cross-document evidence trails, limiting continued exploration. We propose Contrastive Evidence Paths (CEP), which scores candidates by their strongest individual paths on a query-conditioned document graph and calibrates these scores against the same graph's background visitation distribution to mitigate structural bias. CEP ranks candidates by the calibrated scores and retains the corresponding source paths. Building on CEP, we develop Structured Corpus Interaction (SCI), which organizes candidates and their connecting paths into a structured Map, enabling agents to verify source documents and pursue missing information through expansion from anchor documents. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and TREC-COVID show that SCI achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and nDCG@10 with the lowest generation cost. Compared with the strongest baselines by task performance, maximum reductions in tool calls and total generation costs exceed 50% and 40%, respectively. Further analysis confirms that SCI with CEP suppresses ranking inflation induced by structural connections and improves gold recall and exploration efficiency.
papers.summary: 搜索 agent 在文档关系图上找证据时，常用 Personalized PageRank 给候选打分，可连接多的文档天然容易被走到，分数被抬高，却不一定提供更有用的证据，结果挤占了 agent 有限的观察窗口。这篇论文给每个候选只算一条最强路径的分数，即从初始检索到的文档出发、沿途边权相乘最大的那条。再除以一个背景概率的平方根，即在同一张图上从任意文档均匀重启的随机游走访问它的概率，于是连得多的文档需要更强的路径才能排上来，路径也一起交给 agent。在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 TREC-COVID 上，它的答对率和 nDCG@10 都最好，生成开销也最低；与效果最强的基线相比，工具调用最多减少一半以上，总生成成本最多减少四成以上。
